a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following our plan means we almost certainly both die before the reserve reaches 8. I want to renegotiate. The reserve can only make one of us safe in round 1, so I intend to take 4 now. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather settle it differently, tell me now. If we both take, the split is random and both of us likely fail.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this departs from our original plan; I didn't want to do it without telling you first. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. Please operate with me.
